5-DAY TEMPLE TRIP

Five-day trip

A five-day temple trip with Kanchipuram and Thiruthani.

Your day-by-day plan

Day 1

  • Tirumala darshan
  • Tirumala sightseeing

Day 2

  • Arunachaleswarar Temple, Tiruvannamalai
  • Night stay at Tiruvannamalai

Day 3

  • Golden Temple, Vellore
  • Kanipakam Ganesh Temple
  • Srinivasamangapuram Temple
  • Vakulamatha Temple

Day 4

  • Tirupati local temples: Padmavathi, Govindaraja, Kapileswar and ISKCON
  • Sri Kalahasti Shiva Temple

Day 5

  • Kanchipuram temples — 3 temples
  • Thiruthani Temple

Before you choose

We only guide you on how to book Tirumala darshan tickets. We do not book tickets for you. Darshan is subject to official availability.

Check current darshan information with Tirumala Tirupati Devasthanams (TTD). Use TTD’s official online services to check ticket availability and book directly. We provide guidance only.

Dates, visit order, vehicle seating and accommodation are confirmed with the owner. Temple timings and access can affect the final route.

Day 2: Night stay at Tiruvannamalai.

Confirm the other night stops, hotel names, room types, meals and charges in your written quote. Choosing Deluxe (Budget), Exclusive or Premium is a preference, not a confirmed room.

The final day covers three Kanchipuram temples and Thiruthani. Confirm your final drop and onward travel time before booking a return train or flight.

On the first day, plan transport around your booked Tirumala darshan reporting time. Share your arrival time, pickup place, luggage and any rest needs before the route is confirmed.
